Common Questions

Before You Order

How do I use PressaCare?

Add 1 level teaspoon of PressaCare into a cup of hot water and stir well. Take once daily, preferably in the morning before breakfast. Use consistently as directed, as part of a healthy lifestyle.

Is PressaCare meant for daily use?

Yes. PressaCare is designed to be taken once daily as part of a consistent routine. Individual experiences vary, and it is not a substitute for medical advice or treatment.

Can I use PressaCare alongside my prescribed medication?

PressaCare is made from natural herbs. If you are on prescribed blood pressure medication, speak with your doctor first. PressaCare is meant to support your routine, not replace medical treatment.

Are there any side effects?

PressaCare contains no synthetic chemicals or additives and is generally well tolerated by adults. As with any herbal product, stop use and speak with a healthcare provider if you notice any unusual reaction.

Can pregnant women or children use it?

PressaCare is formulated for adults. Pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, and children should speak with a healthcare professional before use.

Do you deliver nationwide?

Yes. We deliver across Nigeria, completely free. WhatsApp or call 0810 869 7043 to confirm delivery timing to your location.

Can I pay on delivery?

Yes, Pay on Delivery is available in all states of Nigeria. Simply fill the order form above and we'll confirm your order before dispatch.
